body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "As of now, guidance continues to be a 25% growth over last year's revenue." Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: +25% (FY24 base INR 3,282 cr -> ~INR 4,100 cr). Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: delivered. Evidence: FY25 revenue INR 4,624 cr vs FY24 3,282 cr = +40.9% (screener; company Q4FY25 call: 'robust growth of 41%').
